candidates: Do not use redundant `import X as X` aliases where the alias is identical to the original name; write `from module import X` directly. In ASE tutorials this commonly arises with optimizer imports — e.g. write `from ase.optimize.fire import FIRE`, not `from ase.optimize.fire import FIRE as FIRE`.

When constraining atoms by element type, use the modern `FixAtoms` API: `FixAtoms(mask=atoms.symbols == 'Symbol')` or `FixAtoms(indices=atoms.symbols.search('Symbol'))`, rather than manual index construction or older string-based patterns.
